description: This file defines the StreamingConverterConfigurator class which implements post-configuration for OrleansJsonSerializerOptions by adding a StreamImplConverter to its converters collection.

classes.name: StreamingConverterConfigurator
classes.description: A class that configures OrleansJsonSerializerOptions post-initialization by adding custom converters.

methods.name: PostConfigure
methods.description: Adds a new StreamImplConverter to the JsonSerializerSettings.Converters collection.
